resources.string: Hide everything on the screen but the switch. The key stays where it is, but it can no longer be deleted by accident.
Short living phrases in small type, in the quiet moments. There are none in a hard moment.
Banks and government services often refuse a visitor arriving from far away. This way they see an ordinary address from home.
Ask GitHub once a day whether a newer build exists. Nothing about you is sent.
Android can open the path by itself every time the phone starts, and let nothing out around it. Set once, and it is the most useful thing that can be done here at all.
1. Tap the button below — the system list of VPNs opens.
2. Next to the line that says Zales, tap the gear. On Samsung phones the line is named the same and the gear is on the right.
4. Then turn on Block connections without VPN. Without that one, the phone gets out to the network around the path in the first seconds after it starts.
While the path is always open, there is no internet at all without it. If the key stops working, turn it off in the same place.
Go through it step by step and see where we stumble. Useful when something is not working right.
Version %1$s is out. You can update.
I could not ask — there seems to be no connection to GitHub right now.
What the app knows about you
The short answer is almost nothing, and none of it goes anywhere. The long one opens at the button: every claim there names the file you can check it in.
What to do if it is not working
Three steps in order. It rarely goes past the first.
First. Lower the switch and lift it again. More than half of it ends here.
Second. Tap Check the path. I will go through it step by step and say in one sentence where we stumbled.
Third. If that did not help either — at the bottom of the check there is a Copy button. Send what it copies to whoever gave you the key: everything they need is in it, and nothing else.
Nothing irreversible has happened. The key is where it was, the phone is fine, the internet has not gone anywhere — it is only the path that is not getting through.
